{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcrnvZ6AbsS71yGQ1btk7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013PTjuvksUJ8jnRZSGNgvMB","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport csv, re\nfrom collections import Counter\nfrom datetime import date\n\nwith open('dataset/employees.csv') as f:\n    employees = list(csv.DictReader(f))\nwith open('dataset/tasks.csv') as f:\n    tasks = list(csv.DictReader(f))\nwith open('dataset/timesheet.csv') as f:\n    ts = list(csv.DictReader(f))\n\npay = {t['task_id']: float(t['pay_per_completion']) for t in tasks}\nrate = {e['PESEL']: float(e['hourly_rate']) for e in employees}\n\ndef parse_tasks(s):\n    return re.findall(r'\\d+', s)\n\n# bonus consistency on rows where ALL tasks known\nmatch=mismatch=0\nmismatches=[]\nfor r in ts:\n    tl = parse_tasks(r['performed_tasks'])\n    if all(t in pay for t in tl):\n        calc = sum(pay[t] for t in tl)\n        if abs(calc - float(r['bonus'])) < 0.01: match+=1\n        else: mismatch+=1; mismatches.append((r['id'], tl, calc, r['bonus']))\nprint(\"bonus matches (all tasks known):\", match, \"mismatches:\", mismatch)\nfor m in mismatches[:15]: print(\"  \", m)\n\n# hours\nprint(\"\\nhours:\", sorted(Counter(r['hours_worked'] for r in ts).items(), key=lambda x: float(x[0])))\n\n# dates\ndates=[]\nbadd=[]\nfor r in ts:\n    try:\n        y,m,d = map(int, r['date'].split('-'))\n        dates.append(date(y,m,d))\n    except Exception as e:\n        badd.append((r['id'], r['date']))\nprint(\"bad dates:\", badd)\nprint(\"min:\", min(dates), min(dates).strftime('%A'), \" max:\", max(dates), max(dates).strftime('%A'))\nprint(\"month counter:\", Counter((d.year,d.month) for d in dates))\n\n# duplicate ids\ndup=[k for k,v in Counter(r['id'] for r in ts).items() if v>1]\nprint(\"dup ids:\", dup)\nfor r in ts:\n    if r['id'] in dup: print(\"  \", r)\n\n# salary_amount consistency check on clean rows\nok=0; bad=0\nfor r in ts:\n    tl = parse_tasks(r['performed_tasks'])\n    if r['employee_id'] in rate and all(t in pay for t in tl):\n        calc = float(r['hours_worked'])*rate[r['employee_id']] + sum(pay[t] for t in tl)\n        if abs(calc - float(r['salary_amount'])) < 0.01: ok+=1\n        else: bad+=1\nprint(\"salary_amount matches:\", ok, \"mismatch:\", bad)\n\n# empty-task rows weekday\nempty=[r for r in ts if not parse_tasks(r['performed_tasks'])]\nprint(\"empty-task rows:\", len(empty), Counter(date(*map(int,r['date'].split('-'))).strftime('%A') for r in empty))\nprint(\"weekday all:\", Counter(d.strftime('%A') for d in dates))\nEOF","description":"Check bonus/salary consistency, hours, dates, duplicates"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1487,"cache_read_input_tokens":29164,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1487,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"266d07a8-a195-4d1a-9251-dad52196ee0c","uuid":"f5569233-8a4a-4664-8353-ce74e725990c","request_id":"req_011CcrnvXmHnPW2S7SxZKkWe"}

<<'EOF'\nimport csv, re\nfrom collections import Counter\nfrom datetime import date, timedelta\n\nwith open('dataset/tasks.csv') as f:\n    tasks = list(csv.DictReader(f))\nwith open('dataset/timesheet.csv') as f:\n    ts = list(csv.DictReader(f))\npay = {t['task_id']: float(t['pay_per_completion']) for t in tasks}\n\ndef parse_tasks(s): return re.findall(r'\\d+', s)\n\ndef fixdate(s):\n    y,m,d = map(int, s.split('-'))\n    while True:\n        try: return date(y,m,d)\n        except ValueError: d-=1\n\n# records in early-May and early-June (before first Tuesday)\nfirst_tue = {3: date(2025,3,4), 4: date(2025,4,1), 5: date(2025,5,6), 6: date(2025,6,3)}\ncnt = Counter()\nfor r in ts:\n    d = fixdate(r['date'])\n    if (d.month==5 and d.day<6) or (d.month==6 and d.day<3):\n        cnt[(d.month, d.day)] += 1\nprint(\"records before first Tuesday of their calendar month:\", sorted(cnt.items()))\n\n# 0-hour rows: do they have tasks?\nzero = [r for r in ts if r['hours_worked']=='0']\nfor r in zero:\n    print(\"0h:\", r['id'], r['date'], fixdate(r['date']).strftime('%a'), parse_tasks(r['performed_tasks']), r['bonus'], r['employee_id'])\n\n# rows with unknown task ids - count\nunk_rows = [r for r in ts if any(t not in pay for t in parse_tasks(r['performed_tasks']))]\nprint(\"\\nrows containing unknown task ids:\", len(unk_rows))\nunk_ids = Counter(t for r in ts for t in parse_tasks(r['performed_tasks']) if t not in pay)\nprint(\"unknown task id counts:\", unk_ids)\n\n# facility ids\nprint(\"\\nfacilities:\", Counter(r['facility_id'] for r in ts))\n\n# exact duplicate (employee,date,hours,tasks)?\nkey = Counter((r['employee_id'], r['date'], r['hours_worked'], r['performed_tasks']) for r in ts)\nprint(\"exact dup rows:\", [k for k,v in key.items() if v>1])\n\n# distinct employees in timesheet after correction\nfix = {'15720759071':'75020759171','16102016795':'96102016751','62020111425':'65020111422',\n       '68011910138':'68011810139','84731091580':'87031491580'}\nemps = Counter(fix.get(r['employee_id'], r['employee_id']) for r in ts)\nprint(\"\\ndistinct employees in timesheet:\", len(emps))\nprint(sorted(emps.items()))\nEOF","description":"Verify billing periods, zero-hour rows, unknown tasks, duplicates"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3726,"cache_read_input_tokens":30651,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":3726,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":7,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"266d07a8-a195-4d1a-9251-dad52196ee0c","uuid":"816c31b2-85bc-4a3b-827b-0ad8e4ac9cb2","request_id":"req_011CcrnyQJf592p54Un5jFtG"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011CcroHR5nnubUhqZfDrFmp","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018NZoNK8tknUJXjCFMNgiUs","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/answer.py","content":"\"\"\"Compute total monthly salaries per employee from the cleaning-service dataset.\n\nCleaning rules derived from data analysis:\n- 48 timesheet rows are byte-identical duplicates of other rows (only `id`\n  differs); each duplicated record is counted once.\n- 5 employee_ids in the timesheet match no employee PESEL (and fail the PESEL\n  checksum). Every such row is a same-date, same-hours shadow copy of an\n  existing valid row of the nearest-PESEL employee, so these rows are\n  injected fakes and are excluded (merging them would double-book days and\n  give those 5 employees far more records than anyone else).\n- Dates 2025-04-31 / 2025-06-31 are impossible; they are corrected by\n  clamping to the last real day of that month (billing-period assignment is\n  unaffected).\n- `performed_tasks` sometimes misses brackets; task ids are extracted by\n  regex. Task ids that don't exist in tasks.csv are dropped.\n- The `bonus` column equals the sum of pay_per_completion of the listed\n  valid tasks on every clean row, so the bonus is recomputed from the task\n  list (this also fixes rows with negative bonuses and perturbed bonuses).\n- The `salary_amount` column is inconsistent with hours*rate+bonus on almost\n  every row and is ignored.\n- Billing periods start on the weekday of the dataset's earliest record\n  (2025-03-04, a Tuesday): each period runs from the first Tuesday of a\n  month to the day before the first Tuesday of the next month.
